title: duscope_by_type
description: The arguments of duscope_by_type, which runs `duscope by-type --no-scan`.

scan_id.description: The saved scan to read: an id duscope_scan or duscope_scans gave (its first 4 or more characters will do), or latest. Default: the newest saved scan that holds the path and was taken with the default options

path.description: A directory or file under one of the server's roots: absolute, or relative to the scan's root. Default: the scan's root, or the server's root when it has one

examples.description: The largest files listed for each kind. Default: 3

glob.description: Only rows whose path matches one of these globs

exclude.description: Leave out rows whose path matches one of these globs

size.description: What rows are ranked and shown by: bytes on disk (allocated, the default) or apparent length

fields.description: The fields of each row, in this order. Default: every field

strict.description: Fail with permission_denied when the scan could not read some directories, instead of answering with a partial_read warning. Default: false
